name: Most wins and most losses player category labels
description: For the players with the most winning and most losing appearances (non-draw matches only; ignore null lineup slots), return exactly two category labels: most_wins and most_losses. Do not use labels like Highest winning matches, Winning matches, or MOST_WINS unless asked. Player identity and match_count values stay unchanged; only the category strings must match most_wins / most_losses.
sql: WITH wins AS (SELECT home_player_1 AS player_api_id, id AS match_id FROM Match WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal AND home_player_1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT home_player_2, id FROM Match WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal AND home_player_2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT home_player_3, id FROM Match WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal AND home_player_3 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT win_counts AS (SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS match_count FROM wins GROUP BY player_api_id), top_win AS (SELECT 'most_wins' AS category, p.player_name, w.match_count FROM win_counts w JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = w.player_api_id ORDER BY w.match_count DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM top_win

name: Season league champions by 3-1-0 points
description: Only for season+league champions with 3/1/0 points from Match goals. One champion per season+league via ROW_NUMBER (points DESC, team_long_name), never RANK. Columns: season, champion_team, league, country, total_points. Do NOT use for player most_wins/most_losses labels or player appearance stats.
sql: WITH team_points AS (SELECT season, country_id, league_id, home_team_api_id AS team_api_id, CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 3 WHEN home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS points FROM Match WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT season, country_id, league_id, away_team_api_id, CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 3 WHEN away_team_goal = home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM Match WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL), totals AS (SELECT season, country_id, league_id, team_api_id, SUM(points) AS total_points FROM team_points GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4), ranked AS (SELECT t.season, tm.team_long_name AS champion_team, l.name AS league, c.name AS country, t.total_points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.season, t.league_id ORDER BY t.total_points DESC, tm.team_long_name) AS rn FROM totals AS t JOIN Team AS tm ON t.team_api_id = tm.team_api_id JOIN League AS l ON t.league_id = l.id JOIN Country AS c ON t.country_id = c.id) SELECT season, champion_team, league, country, total_points FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY season, country
